overview.en:
The Qwen3 Embedding model series is the latest proprietary model family of the Qwen series, specifically designed for text embedding and ranking tasks. Built upon the dense foundational models of the Qwen3 series, it provides a comprehensive range of text embeddings and reranking models in various sizes (0.6B, 4B, and 8B). Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B is the smallest variant, optimized for fast, low-cost embedding serving.

vLLM Ascend 0.9.2rc1 and higher versions support this model.
overview.zh:
Qwen3 Embedding 系列是 Qwen 家族最新的专有模型，专为文本嵌入与排序任务设计。该系列基于 Qwen3 稠密基座模型构建，提供多种规格（0.6B、4B、8B）的文本嵌入与重排序模型。Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B 是该系列最小规格，面向快速、低成本的嵌入服务。

仅 vLLM Ascend 0.9.2rc1 及以上版本支持该模型。

env_setup.container.A2.content.en:
You can use the official all-in-one Docker image to run `Qwen3-Embedding` directly.

**Docker Pull:**

```bash
docker pull quay.io/ascend/vllm-ascend:v0.30.0rc2
```

**Docker Run:**

```bash
export IMAGE=quay.io/ascend/vllm-ascend:v0.30.0rc2

docker run --rm \
    --name vllm-ascend \
    --shm-size=1g \
    --net=host \
    --privileged=true \
    --device /dev/davinci0 \
    --device /dev/davinci_manager \
    --device /dev/devmm_svm \
    --device /dev/hisi_hdc \
    -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
    -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/tools/hccn_tool:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/tools/hccn_tool \
    -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
    -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/lib64/:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/lib64/ \
    -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info \
    -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
    -v /root/.cache:/root/.cache \
    -it $IMAGE bash
```

After a successful docker run, you can verify the running container service by executing the `docker ps` command.

scenarios[0].steps[0].content.en:
Single-card pooling deployment completes both Prefill and Decode within the same NPU, suitable for development, testing, and small-to-medium scale embedding serving scenarios.

The following command is an example configuration. Adjust the parameters based on your actual scenario.

```bash
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B \
    --served-model-name Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B \
    --runner pooling \
    --port 8000 \
    --max-model-len {{max_model_len}}
```

> - `--max-model-len` represents the context length, which is the maximum value of the input plus output for a single request. If automatic parsing resolves to a large context length, allocating this mask (O(max_model_len^2)) may exceed NPU memory and trigger OOM. Be sure to set an explicit and conservative value, such as 1024.
> - Replace `Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B` with your local weight directory if you pre-downloaded the model.
scenarios[0].steps[0].content.zh:
单卡 pooling 部署在同一块 NPU 上完成嵌入计算，适合开发、测试与中小规模嵌入服务场景。

以下命令为示例配置，请根据实际场景调整参数。

```bash
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B \
    --served-model-name Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B \
    --runner pooling \
    --port 8000 \
    --max-model-len {{max_model_len}}
```

> - `--max-model-len` 表示上下文长度，即单条请求输入与输出的最大 token 数。若自动解析得到较大的上下文长度，分配该掩码（O(max_model_len^2)）可能超出 NPU 显存并触发 OOM。请务必显式设置保守值，例如 1024。
> - 如已提前下载权重，请将 `Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B` 替换为本地权重目录。

scenarios[0].steps[1].content.en: After the service is started, verify it is running by sending an embedding request. Refer to the verification section below for a usage example.
scenarios[0].steps[1].content.zh: 服务启动后，发送一条嵌入请求进行验证。用法示例参见下方"服务验证"部分。

scenarios[1].steps[0].content.en:
Atlas 300I DUO single-node pooling deployment (TP=1).

```bash
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B \
    --served-model-name Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B \
    --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_capture_sizes": [1024,512]}' \
    --additional-config '{"ascend_compilation_config": {"fuse_norm_quant": false}}' \
    --runner pooling \
    --dtype float16 \
    --port 8000 \
    --max-model-len {{max_model_len}}
```

> - `--compilation-config`: For Atlas 300I DUO, due to limited hardware streams, the size of `cudagraph_capture_sizes` is restricted.
> - `--dtype float16` matches the Atlas 300I DUO inference execution path.
> - `--max-model-len`: if automatic parsing resolves to a large context length, allocating this mask (O(max_model_len^2)) may exceed NPU memory and trigger OOM. Be sure to set an explicit and conservative value, such as 1024.
scenarios[1].steps[0].content.zh:
Atlas 300I DUO 单节点 pooling 部署（TP=1）。

```bash
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B \
    --served-model-name Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B \
    --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_capture_sizes": [1024,512]}' \
    --additional-config '{"ascend_compilation_config": {"fuse_norm_quant": false}}' \
    --runner pooling \
    --dtype float16 \
    --port 8000 \
    --max-model-len {{max_model_len}}
```

> - `--compilation-config`：Atlas 300I DUO 受硬件流数量限制，需要限制 `cudagraph_capture_sizes` 的规模。
> - `--dtype float16`：与 Atlas 300I DUO 推理执行路径一致。
> - `--max-model-len`：若自动解析得到较大的上下文长度，分配该掩码（O(max_model_len^2)）可能超出 NPU 显存并触发 OOM。请务必显式设置保守值，例如 1024。

evaluation.accuracy.content.en:
### Using MTEB

Refer to [MTEB](https://docs.mteb.org/) for details.

Run the following code to execute the accuracy evaluation:

```python
import os
import mteb

from mteb.models.vllm_wrapper import VllmEncoderWrapper

if __name__ == "__main__":
    data_path = "/home/data/mteb_data"
    os.environ["HF_DATASETS_CACHE"] = data_path
    os.environ["HF_ENDPOINT"] = "https://hf-mirror.com"

    model = VllmEncoderWrapper("/root/.cache/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B",
                                revision="norm",
                                dtype="float16",
                                max_model_len=10240,
                                )

    cache = mteb.ResultCache(data_path)
    tasks = mteb.get_tasks(tasks=["LeCaRDv2"])
    results = mteb.evaluate(model, tasks=tasks, cache=cache, encode_kwargs={"batch_size": 2}, overwrite_strategy="always")
    df = results.to_dataframe()
    print(df)
```

After execution, you can get the evaluation result.
evaluation.accuracy.content.zh:
### 使用 MTEB

详见 [MTEB](https://docs.mteb.org/)。

运行以下代码执行精度评测：

```python
import os
import mteb

from mteb.models.vllm_wrapper import VllmEncoderWrapper

if __name__ == "__main__":
    data_path = "/home/data/mteb_data"
    os.environ["HF_DATASETS_CACHE"] = data_path
    os.environ["HF_ENDPOINT"] = "https://hf-mirror.com"

    model = VllmEncoderWrapper("/root/.cache/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B",
                                revision="norm",
                                dtype="float16",
                                max_model_len=10240,
                                )

    cache = mteb.ResultCache(data_path)
    tasks = mteb.get_tasks(tasks=["LeCaRDv2"])
    results = mteb.evaluate(model, tasks=tasks, cache=cache, encode_kwargs={"batch_size": 2}, overwrite_strategy="always")
    df = results.to_dataframe()
    print(df)
```

执行完成后即可得到评测结果。

evaluation.performance.content.en:
### Using vLLM Benchmark

Run performance of `Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B` as an example. Refer to [vllm benchmark](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/benchmarking/cli/) for more details.

Take the `serve` subcommand as an example. Run the code as follows:

```bash
vllm bench serve \
    --model Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B \
    --backend openai-embeddings \
    --port 8000 \
    --dataset-name random \
    --endpoint /v1/embeddings \
    --random-input 200 \
    --save-result \
    --result-dir ./
```

After about several minutes, you can get the performance evaluation result.
evaluation.performance.content.zh:

以 `Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B` 的性能评测为例，详见 [vllm benchmark](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/benchmarking/cli/)。

以 `serve` 子命令为例，运行以下命令：

```bash
vllm bench serve \
    --model Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B \
    --backend openai-embeddings \
    --port 8000 \
    --dataset-name random \
    --endpoint /v1/embeddings \
```

等待数分钟即可获得性能评测结果。

performance.benchmark.en:
No fixed throughput/latency numbers are published for this model; results depend on hardware resources, input length, concurrency, and runtime configuration.

Use the reproducible `vllm bench serve --backend openai-embeddings` command in the "More Info" tab to measure embedding throughput and latency on your own deployment.

请使用"更多信息"页签中可复现的 `vllm bench serve --backend openai-embeddings` 命令，在自己的部署环境实测嵌入吞吐与延迟。
